extension.summary: Synchronised playback across two or more Kodi boxes sharing a Jellyfin server
extension.description:
Synchronised playback for two or more Kodi installs sharing the same Jellyfin server, driven over Kodi's JSON-RPC API. Leader/Follower: the leader forwards play, pause, seek and stop to the follower, so the same item plays on both screens at the same position. Sync Group: up to eleven boxes, each listing the others; whichever box starts a film opens it everywhere, pause and resume from any box reach all of them, and a box switched on mid-film joins at the right position.
Install on every box. Leader/Follower: set one to Leader and point it at the other's IP, set the other to Follower. Sync Group: set every box to Sync Group member and fill in the device slots. Every box that receives commands needs Settings > Services > Control > "Allow remote control via HTTP" and "Allow remote control from applications on other systems" enabled.
extension.news: 2.1.4: A powered off box no longer delays the others; player events are handled off Kodi's callback thread; restarting a film just after joining hosts it properly; a real pause or stop right after a mirrored one is no longer swallowed; exiting Kodi sends the departure; Test connection shows progress. 2.1.3: Starting something on any box always takes over the group; a box coming online while the group is paused joins paused at the same point; a repeat start event no longer restarts the session. 2.1.0: Sync Group: 10 named device slots, pause/resume from any device echoes to all, stopping pauses everyone else and says which device left, and a device coming online mid-film joins where the others are. 2.0.0: Peer mode: any number of boxes, whichever one starts a film drives the rest, and pause/resume/seek from ANY box mirrors to all. Leader/Follower mode unchanged. 1.2.0: "When this box stops" option: stop the follower, pause it (stop in one room, press play in the other to carry on), or leave it playing. 1.1.0: New option "Stop follower on stop/exit": turn it off and stopping or exiting the leader leaves the follower playing; play/pause/seek still mirror. 1.0.2: Settings dialog: shorter labels that fit the list, full explanations shown as help text, proper strings.po. 1.0.1: Reliability fixes: explicit play/pause instead of toggling, follower no longer left playing if the leader stops mid-handshake, resume no longer drags the follower behind, faster shutdown response.
